datasets.name: Call Center
datasets.description: A slowly changing dimension table that maintains the history of call center facilities, including their operational attributes, geographic location, organizational hierarchy, and market assignment. Each row represents a version of a call center with effective date ranges.

fields.name: Call Center Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key that identifies each row in the call center dimension table.

fields.name: Call Center ID
fields.description: Business identifier for the call center facility, used to track the same physical location across multiple versions in the slowly changing dimension.

fields.name: Record Start Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the call center record became effective.

fields.name: Record End Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the call center record expired; null indicates the current active version.

fields.name: Closed Date Surrogate Key
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the date dimension for when the call center closed; always null in this dataset.

fields.name: Open Date
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the date dimension indicating when the call center opened.

fields.name: Call Center Name
fields.description: The geographic or regional name of the call center facility.

fields.name: Call Center Class
fields.description: The size classification of the call center, such as 'large' or 'medium'.

fields.name: Employee Count
fields.description: The number of employees working at the call center.

fields.name: Square Footage
fields.description: The physical size of the call center facility in square feet.

fields.name: Operating Hours
fields.description: The daily operating hours of the call center, such as '8AM-4PM' or '8AM-8AM'.

fields.name: Call Center Manager
fields.description: The name of the manager responsible for the call center facility.

fields.name: Market ID
fields.description: Identifier for the marketing region to which the call center is assigned.

fields.name: Market Class
fields.description: Classification or category of the marketing region.

fields.name: Market Description
fields.description: Descriptive text about the marketing region and its characteristics.

fields.name: Market Manager
fields.description: The name of the manager responsible for the marketing region.

fields.name: Division ID
fields.description: Identifier for the organizational division to which the call center belongs.

fields.name: Division Name
fields.description: The name of the organizational division to which the call center belongs.

fields.name: Company ID
fields.description: Identifier for the legal company to which the call center belongs.

fields.name: Company Name
fields.description: The name of the legal company to which the call center belongs.

fields.name: Street Number
fields.description: The street number component of the call center's address.

fields.name: Street Name
fields.description: The street name component of the call center's address.

fields.name: Street Type
fields.description: The street type component of the call center's address, such as 'Boulevard' or 'Way'.

fields.name: Suite Number
fields.description: The suite or unit number component of the call center's address.

fields.name: City
fields.description: The city where the call center is located.

fields.name: County
fields.description: The county where the call center is located.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The state or province where the call center is located.

fields.name: Zip Code
fields.description: The postal zip code where the call center is located.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: The country where the call center is located.

fields.name: GMT Offset
fields.description: The time-zone offset from GMT in hours for the call center's location.

fields.name: Tax Percentage
fields.description: The sales tax rate applied at the call center's location.

datasets.name: Catalog Page
datasets.description: A dimension table that describes pages in printed catalogs. Each row represents a unique catalog page with its validity dates, catalog and page numbers, department, type, and descriptive information. This table is used to provide context for catalog sales and returns transactions.

fields.name: Catalog Page Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique surrogate key that identifies each catalog page record.

fields.name: Catalog Page ID
fields.description: A unique business identifier for each catalog page.

fields.name: Start Date
fields.description: The date when the catalog page became valid, linked to the date dimension table.

fields.name: End Date
fields.description: The date when the catalog page was no longer valid, linked to the date dimension table.

fields.name: Department
fields.description: The department classification for the catalog page. Currently contains a single value in the dataset.

fields.name: Catalog Number
fields.description: The catalog number that identifies which catalog edition this page belongs to.

fields.name: Catalog Page Number
fields.description: The page number within the catalog, indicating the sequential position of this page.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A text description of the catalog page content or theme.

fields.name: Catalog Type
fields.description: The publication frequency or type of the catalog, such as bi-annual or quarterly.

datasets.name: Catalog Returns
datasets.description: Records individual catalog order returns processed by the retailer, including quantities, refund amounts, fees, and the customers and locations involved. Each row represents one item returned from a catalog order.

fields.name: Returned Date
fields.description: Date the return was processed, linked to the date dimension for time-based analysis.

fields.name: Time of Day
fields.description: Time of day the return was processed, linked to the time dimension with hour, minute, and shift attributes.

fields.name: Item
fields.description: The product that was returned, linked to the item dimension which includes versioned pricing and attributes.

fields.name: Refunded Customer
fields.description: The customer who received the refund, typically the original buyer of the catalog order.

fields.name: Refunded Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic attributes of the customer receiving the refund, linked to the customer demographics dimension.

fields.name: Refunded Household Demographics
fields.description: Household demographic attributes of the customer receiving the refund, linked to the household demographics dimension.

fields.name: Refunded Address
fields.description: Address where the refund was sent, linked to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: Returning Customer
fields.description: The customer who physically returned the goods, which may differ from the refunded customer.

fields.name: Returning Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic attributes of the customer who physically returned the goods, linked to the customer demographics dimension.

fields.name: Returning Household Demographics
fields.description: Household demographic attributes of the customer who physically returned the goods, linked to the household demographics dimension.

fields.name: Returning Address
fields.description: Address from which the goods were returned, linked to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: Call Center
fields.description: The call center facility that processed the return, linked to the call center dimension.

fields.name: Catalog Page
fields.description: The page in the printed catalog from which the returned item was originally ordered, linked to the catalog page dimension.

fields.name: Ship Mode
fields.description: The shipping service level and carrier used for the original order, linked to the ship mode dimension.

fields.name: Warehouse
fields.description: The distribution facility that shipped the original order, linked to the warehouse dimension.

fields.name: Return Reason
fields.description: The reason code provided by the customer for the return, linked to the reason dimension.

fields.name: Order Number
fields.description: Identifier of the catalog order from which this item was returned; groups all line items of one order.

fields.name: Return Quantity
fields.description: Number of units returned on this line item.

fields.name: Return Amount
fields.description: Value of the returned goods refunded to the customer, before tax, in dollars.

fields.name: Return Tax
fields.description: Tax refunded on the return, in dollars.

fields.name: Return Amount Including Tax
fields.description: Total refund amount including tax, calculated as Return Amount + Return Tax, in dollars.

fields.name: Return Fee
fields.description: Restocking or handling fee charged to the customer for the return, in dollars.

fields.name: Return Ship Cost
fields.description: Shipping cost incurred to return the goods to the retailer, in dollars.

fields.name: Refunded Cash
fields.description: Portion of the refund paid to the customer in cash, in dollars.

fields.name: Reversed Charge
fields.description: Portion of the refund returned by reversing the original card charge, in dollars.

fields.name: Store Credit
fields.description: Portion of the refund issued as store or account credit to the customer, in dollars.

fields.name: Net Loss
fields.description: Total financial loss to the retailer from the return, in dollars. Verify exact calculation formula before use in critical analyses.

datasets.name: Catalog Sales
datasets.description: Transactional fact table capturing individual line items from catalog and web orders, including customer, product, pricing, and fulfillment details. Each row represents one item sold through a catalog or web channel.

fields.name: Sold Date
fields.description: Date the sale was made, linked to the date dimension for time-based analysis.

fields.name: Time of Day
fields.description: Time of day the sale was made, linked to the time dimension with hour, minute, and meal-time attributes.

fields.name: Ship Date
fields.description: Date the catalog or web order was shipped.

fields.name: Bill-To Customer
fields.description: Customer who was billed for the order; links to the customer dimension.

fields.name: Bill-To Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic profile of the billing customer including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: Bill-To Household Demographics
fields.description: Household-level profile of the billing address including income band, buying potential, dependents, and vehicles.

fields.name: Bill-To Address
fields.description: Postal address where the customer was billed; links to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: Ship-To Customer
fields.description: Customer the goods were shipped to; links to the customer dimension.

fields.name: Ship-To Customer Demographics
fields.description: Demographic profile of the shipping customer including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: Ship-To Household Demographics
fields.description: Household-level profile of the shipping address including income band, buying potential, dependents, and vehicles.

fields.name: Ship-To Address
fields.description: Postal address where the goods were shipped; links to the customer address dimension.

fields.name: Call Center
fields.description: Call center facility that took the catalog order; links to the call center dimension.

fields.name: Catalog Page
fields.description: Page in the printed catalog from which the item was ordered; links to the catalog page dimension.

fields.name: Ship Mode
fields.description: Shipping service level and carrier used for the order; links to the ship mode dimension.

fields.name: Warehouse
fields.description: Distribution facility that shipped the order; links to the warehouse dimension.

fields.name: Item
fields.description: Product sold; links to the item dimension which is versioned over time for price and attribute changes.

fields.name: Promotion
fields.description: Marketing campaign offering a discount on the item over a date range; links to the promotion dimension.

fields.name: Order Number
fields.description: Identifier of the catalog or web order; groups all line items belonging to a single order.

fields.name: Quantity Sold
fields.description: Number of units of the item on this sales line.

fields.name: Unit Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Per-unit cost to the retailer at the time of sale, in dollars.

fields.name: Unit List Price
fields.description: Per-unit list (undiscounted) price at the time of sale, in dollars.

fields.name: Unit Sales Price
fields.description: Per-unit price actually charged before coupons, in dollars.

fields.name: Extended Discount Amount
fields.description: Quantity Sold × (Unit List Price − Unit Sales Price); total markdown from list price, in dollars.

fields.name: Extended Sales Price
fields.description: Quantity Sold × Unit Sales Price; gross line revenue before coupons and tax, in dollars.

fields.name: Extended Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Quantity Sold × Unit Wholesale Cost; total cost to the retailer for this line, in dollars.

fields.name: Extended List Price
fields.description: Quantity Sold × Unit List Price; total undiscounted value of the line, in dollars.

fields.name: Extended Tax
fields.description: Sales tax charged on the line, computed on Net Paid, in dollars.

fields.name: Coupon Amount
fields.description: Coupon discount applied to the line after the sales price, in dollars.

fields.name: Extended Ship Cost
fields.description: Shipping charge on the catalog or web line, in dollars.

fields.name: Net Paid
fields.description: Extended Sales Price − Coupon Amount; revenue the customer actually paid before tax and shipping, in dollars.

fields.name: Net Paid Including Tax
fields.description: Net Paid + Extended Tax; total revenue including sales tax but before shipping, in dollars.

fields.name: Net Paid Including Ship
fields.description: Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost; total revenue including shipping but before tax, in dollars.

fields.name: Net Paid Including Ship and Tax
fields.description: Net Paid + Extended Ship Cost + Extended Tax; total revenue including both shipping and tax, in dollars.
glossary_terms: Net Paid Including Ship and Tax

fields.name: Net Profit
fields.description: Net Paid − Extended Wholesale Cost; line-level gross profit before operating expenses, in dollars.

datasets.name: Customer
datasets.description: Master dimension table containing all customers who have purchased from any channel (catalog, store, or web). Each row represents a unique customer with their demographic profile, contact information, and purchase history dates.

fields.name: Customer Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key assigned to each customer for efficient joins with transaction tables.

fields.name: Customer ID
fields.description: Natural business identifier for the customer, a unique alphanumeric code assigned at customer creation.

fields.name: Current Customer Demographics
fields.description: Link to the customer's current demographic profile including gender, marital status, education, credit rating, and dependents.

fields.name: Current Household Demographics
fields.description: Link to the customer's current household profile including income band, buying potential, number of dependents, and vehicles owned.

fields.name: Current Address
fields.description: Link to the customer's current postal address used for billing and shipping.

fields.name: First Ship-To Date
fields.description: Date key referencing when the customer's first order was shipped across any channel.

fields.name: First Sale Date
fields.description: Date key referencing when the customer made their first purchase in any channel.

fields.name: Salutation
fields.description: Customer's title or form of address (e.g., Dr., Mr., Mrs., Ms., Sir, Madam).

fields.name: First Name
fields.description: Customer's given name.

fields.name: Last Name
fields.description: Customer's family name.

fields.name: Preferred Customer Flag
fields.description: Indicator (Y/N) showing whether the customer is enrolled in the preferred or loyalty program.

fields.name: Birth Day
fields.description: Day of the month (1-31) on which the customer was born.

fields.name: Birth Month
fields.description: Month (1-12) in which the customer was born.

fields.name: Birth Year
fields.description: Year in which the customer was born, ranging from 1924 to 1992.

fields.name: Birth Country
fields.description: Country in which the customer was born.

fields.name: Customer Login
fields.description: Customer's web login username for online account access.

fields.name: Email Address
fields.description: Customer's email address used for communications and account recovery.

fields.name: Last Review Date
fields.description: Date key indicating when the customer record was last reviewed or updated in the system.

datasets.name: Customer Address
datasets.description: A dimension table containing postal addresses for customers, used across all sales channels (catalog, store, and web) for billing, shipping, and refund purposes. Each row represents a unique address with geographic and location-type attributes.

fields.name: Address Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key for each address record, used internally to link addresses across fact tables.

fields.name: Address ID
fields.description: Natural business identifier for the address, providing a human-readable reference.

fields.name: Street Number
fields.description: The numeric portion of the street address (e.g., house or building number).

fields.name: Street Name
fields.description: The name of the street or road.

fields.name: Street Type
fields.description: The type of street (e.g., Avenue, Boulevard, Way), used to categorize address formats.

proposed_term.name: Street Type
proposed_term.definition: Classification of street designation such as Avenue, Boulevard, Street, Way, or Court.

fields.name: Suite Number
fields.description: The suite, apartment, or unit number within a building, used to distinguish multiple addresses at the same street location.

proposed_term.name: Suite Number
proposed_term.definition: Apartment, suite, or unit designation for multi-unit addresses.

fields.name: City
fields.description: The city or municipality where the address is located, part of the geographic hierarchy.

fields.name: County
fields.description: The county where the address is located, part of the geographic hierarchy.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The U.S. state abbreviation (e.g., CA, NY, TX), used to group and filter addresses by state.

fields.name: ZIP Code
fields.description: The postal ZIP code for the address, enabling precise geographic targeting.

fields.name: Country
fields.description: The country where the address is located; currently all values are 'United States'.

fields.name: GMT Offset
fields.description: The time-zone offset from GMT in hours, ranging from -10 to -5, used for time-based analysis and reporting.

fields.name: Location Type
fields.description: The type of dwelling at the address (apartment, house, or single family), used to segment customers by residence type.

datasets.name: Customer Demographics
datasets.description: A dimension table containing demographic attributes for customers, including gender, marital status, education level, credit rating, and household composition. This table is referenced across all sales and returns transactions to enable demographic analysis and segmentation.

fields.name: Customer Demographics Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key identifying each customer demographic profile record.

fields.name: Gender
fields.description: Customer gender, either Female (F) or Male (M).

fields.name: Marital Status
fields.description: Customer marital status code, such as Divorced (D), Married (M), Single (S), Widowed (W), or Unknown.

fields.name: Education Status
fields.description: Highest education level attained by the customer, including categories such as 2 yr Degree, 4 yr Degree, Advanced Degree, High School, Primary, and Unknown.

fields.name: Purchase Estimate
fields.description: Estimated annual purchase amount band for the customer in whole currency units, ranging from $500 to $10,000 in increments.

fields.name: Credit Rating
fields.description: Credit risk classification of the customer, such as Good, Fair, Poor, or Unknown.

fields.name: Dependent Count
fields.description: Total number of dependents in the customer's household, ranging from 0 to 6.

fields.name: Employed Dependent Count
fields.description: Number of dependents in the customer's household who are employed, ranging from 0 to 6.

fields.name: College Dependent Count
fields.description: Number of dependents in the customer's household who are attending college, ranging from 0 to 6.

datasets.name: Date Dimension
datasets.description: A comprehensive calendar dimension table containing one row per day from 1900 to 2100, with calendar attributes (year, month, day, quarter, week), fiscal period mappings, day-of-week and holiday indicators, and period-over-period comparison keys for analyzing sales and business events across time.

fields.name: Date Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key for each calendar date, used as the primary identifier and foreign key in fact tables.

fields.name: Date ID
fields.description: Alternate unique identifier for each calendar date in string format.

fields.name: Calendar Date
fields.description: The actual calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD format) represented by this row.

fields.name: Month Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each month, useful for period arithmetic and calculating month-over-month intervals.

fields.name: Week Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each week, useful for week-over-week analysis and period calculations.

fields.name: Quarter Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each quarter, useful for quarter-over-quarter analysis and period calculations.

fields.name: Calendar Year
fields.description: The calendar year (1900–2100) of the date, used for annual grouping and year-over-year comparisons.

fields.name: Day of Week Number
fields.description: Numeric day of week (0–6), where 0 typically represents Sunday, used for weekday-based analysis and filtering.

fields.name: Month of Year
fields.description: The month number (1–12) within the calendar year, used for monthly grouping and seasonal analysis.

fields.name: Day of Month
fields.description: The day number (1–31) within the calendar month, used for intra-month analysis and date positioning.

fields.name: Quarter of Year
fields.description: The quarter number (1–4) within the calendar year, used for quarterly grouping and seasonal analysis.

fields.name: Fiscal Year
fields.description: The fiscal year of the date, used for fiscal period grouping and year-over-year comparisons aligned to the organization's fiscal calendar.

fields.name: Fiscal Quarter Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each fiscal quarter, useful for fiscal period arithmetic and comparisons.

fields.name: Fiscal Week Sequence
fields.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for each fiscal week, useful for fiscal week-over-week analysis and period calculations.

fields.name: Day of Week Name
fields.description: The name of the day of the week (e.g., Monday, Tuesday), used for readable day-based filtering and reporting.

fields.name: Quarter Name
fields.description: A formatted quarter label (e.g., '2023Q1') combining the year and quarter number for readable period identification.

fields.name: Is Holiday
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date is a recognized holiday, used for holiday-specific analysis and filtering.

fields.name: Is Weekend
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls on a weekend (Saturday or Sunday), used for weekend vs. weekday analysis.

fields.name: Following Holiday
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date is immediately followed by a holiday, used to identify pre-holiday periods.

fields.name: First Day of Month Surrogate Key
fields.description: Surrogate key pointing to the first day of the month containing this date, enabling month-start analysis and calculations.

fields.name: Last Day of Month Surrogate Key
fields.description: Surrogate key pointing to the last day of the month containing this date, enabling month-end analysis and calculations.

fields.name: Same Day Last Year Surrogate Key
fields.description: Surrogate key of the equivalent calendar day one year earlier, enabling year-over-year period-on-period comparisons.

fields.name: Same Day Last Quarter Surrogate Key
fields.description: Surrogate key of the equivalent calendar day one quarter earlier, enabling quarter-over-quarter period-on-period comparisons.

fields.name: Is Current Day
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date is the current business day, used for current-period filtering in reports.

fields.name: Is Current Week
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls within the current business week, used for current-period filtering in reports.

fields.name: Is Current Month
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls within the current business month, used for current-period filtering in reports.

fields.name: Is Current Quarter
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls within the current business quarter, used for current-period filtering in reports.

fields.name: Is Current Year
fields.description: Flag ('Y' or 'N') indicating whether the date falls within the current business year, used for current-period filtering in reports.

datasets.name: Household Demographics
datasets.description: A dimension table that describes household-level demographic profiles, including income band, buying potential, number of dependents, and vehicle ownership. Each row represents a unique household demographic profile used to segment customers across sales and returns transactions.

fields.name: Household Demographics Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key that identifies each household demographic profile.

fields.name: Income Band Key
fields.description: Foreign key reference to the Income Band dimension table, linking each household to its annual income range.

fields.name: Buy Potential
fields.description: Estimated household annual spending band, categorized into ranges such as 0-500, 500-1000, 1000-5000, 5000-10000, 10000-50000, or Unknown.

fields.name: Dependent Count
fields.description: Number of dependents in the household, ranging from 0 to 9.

fields.name: Vehicle Count
fields.description: Number of vehicles owned by the household, ranging from -1 (unknown) to 4.

datasets.name: Income Band
datasets.description: A lookup table that defines household annual income ranges. Each row represents a distinct income band with a lower and upper bound, used to segment customers and households by income level.

fields.name: Income Band Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key that identifies each income band record.

fields.name: Lower Bound
fields.description: The minimum annual household income (in dollars) for this income band, inclusive.

fields.name: Upper Bound
fields.description: The maximum annual household income (in dollars) for this income band, inclusive.

datasets.name: Inventory
datasets.description: Weekly snapshots of inventory levels by item and warehouse. Each row represents the quantity of a specific item on hand at a warehouse on a given date.

fields.name: Inventory Date
fields.description: The date key identifying when this inventory snapshot was taken, linking to the date dimension table.

fields.name: Item
fields.description: The item key identifying which product this inventory record describes, linking to the item dimension table.

fields.name: Warehouse
fields.description: The warehouse key identifying which distribution facility holds this inventory, linking to the warehouse dimension table.

fields.name: Quantity On Hand
fields.description: Units of the item held at the warehouse on the snapshot date. This is the primary measure tracked in inventory snapshots.

datasets.name: Item
datasets.description: A slowly changing dimension table that maintains the history of products sold by the retailer. Each row represents a version of an item with its attributes, pricing, and classification valid during a specific time period.

fields.name: Item Surrogate Key
fields.description: Unique surrogate key that identifies each item record.

fields.name: Item ID
fields.description: Business key that identifies the logical item across all its versions.

fields.name: Record Start Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the item became effective.

fields.name: Record End Date
fields.description: The date when this version of the item expired; null indicates the current version.

fields.name: Item Description
fields.description: Detailed text description of the item.

fields.name: Current Price
fields.description: Current list price of this item version in dollars.

fields.name: Wholesale Cost
fields.description: Standard per-unit cost the retailer pays for this item in dollars.

fields.name: Brand ID
fields.description: Identifier for the brand of the item.

fields.name: Brand
fields.description: Brand name of the item.

fields.name: Class ID
fields.description: Identifier for the product class, the second level of the product hierarchy.

fields.name: Class
fields.description: Product class name, the second level of the product hierarchy within a category.

fields.name: Category ID
fields.description: Identifier for the product category, the top level of the product hierarchy.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Product category name, the top level of the product hierarchy.

fields.name: Manufacturer ID
fields.description: Identifier for the manufacturer of the item.

fields.name: Manufacturer
fields.description: Name of the manufacturer of the item.

fields.name: Size
fields.description: Physical size attribute of the item.

fields.name: Formulation
fields.description: Technical formulation code or specification for the item.

fields.name: Color
fields.description: Color attribute of the item.

fields.name: Units
fields.description: Unit of measure for the item (e.g., Box, Case, Pound).

fields.name: Container
fields.description: Container type for the item; currently all values are 'Unknown'.

fields.name: Product Manager ID
fields.description: Identifier of the manager responsible for this item.

fields.name: Product Name
fields.description: Display name of the product.

datasets.name: Promotion
datasets.description: A dimension table containing marketing campaign promotions with their characteristics, channels, costs, and validity periods. Each row represents a unique promotion that can be applied to items and referenced in sales transactions.

fields.name: Promotion Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique numeric identifier for each promotion, used as the primary key and to link promotions to sales transactions.

fields.name: Promotion ID
fields.description: A unique business identifier for each promotion, providing a human-readable reference code.

fields.name: Promotion Start Date
fields.description: A reference to the date dimension indicating when the promotion begins. Links to the date_dim table to provide the actual start date.

fields.name: Promotion End Date
fields.description: A reference to the date dimension indicating when the promotion ends. Links to the date_dim table to provide the actual end date.

fields.name: Item
fields.description: A reference to the item being promoted, linking to the item dimension table. Most promotions apply to a specific product.

fields.name: Promotion Cost
fields.description: The amount spent to run the promotion, expressed in dollars. This represents the investment required to execute the marketing campaign.

fields.name: Promotion Response Target
fields.description: A numeric indicator of the expected or desired response level for the promotion, used to set expectations for campaign performance.

fields.name: Promotion Name
fields.description: A short descriptive name or category for the promotion, such as 'able' or 'pri', used to classify and identify promotion types.

fields.name: Direct Mail Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through direct mail.

fields.name: Email Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through email. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: Catalog Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through a catalog. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: Television Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through television. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: Radio Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through radio. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: Press Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through press or print media. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: Event Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through events. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: Demo Channel
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion was communicated through product demonstrations. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

fields.name: Channel Details
fields.description: Free-form text providing additional details about the promotion channels and communication strategy used.

fields.name: Promotion Purpose
fields.description: The business purpose or objective of the promotion. In this dataset, all values are 'Unknown'.

fields.name: Discount Active
fields.description: A flag (Y/N) indicating whether the promotion's discount was actively in effect. In this dataset, all values are 'N'.

datasets.name: Reason
datasets.description: A lookup table containing the reasons customers provide for product returns across all sales channels (catalog, store, and web). Each reason is identified by a surrogate key and a business key, with a descriptive text explaining the return rationale.

fields.name: Reason Surrogate Key
fields.description: A unique numeric identifier assigned to each return reason for efficient referencing in fact tables.

fields.name: Reason ID
fields.description: A unique business identifier (natural key) for each return reason, used in source systems and data loads.

fields.name: Reason Description

relationships.reason: cc_mkt_id (market ID) should not reference s_store_sk (store surrogate key). Market IDs are business keys for market segments, while s_store_sk is a surrogate key for individual stores. Column names suggest different semantic meanings. Likely coincidence with small cardinality (3 values).

i_class_id (item class identifier) should not reference ib_income_band_sk (income band surrogate key). These are unrelated business concepts - item classification has no logical connection to household income bands. Coincidental overlap of small integer ranges.

i_category_id (item category) should not reference s_store_sk (store surrogate key). Item categories and store locations are independent dimensions with no logical relationship. Column names indicate different purposes. Coincidence with small cardinality (10 values).

i_manufact_id (manufacturer ID) should not reference hd_demo_sk (household demographics surrogate key). Manufacturers and household demographic profiles are unrelated concepts. While cardinality is larger (994), the semantic mismatch is clear and this appears to be coincidental overlap.

i_manager_id (item manager identifier) should not reference p_promo_sk (promotion surrogate key). These represent different business entities with no logical relationship. Column names suggest different purposes. Coincidental overlap of similar cardinality ranges.

s_market_id (store market identifier) should not reference ib_income_band_sk (income band surrogate key). Market segments and income bands are different classification schemes. Column names indicate distinct purposes. Coincidence with small cardinality (7 values).

s_division_id (store division) should not reference w_warehouse_sk (warehouse surrogate key). These are different organizational hierarchies. The single distinct value (1) suggests this is a constant or placeholder, not a meaningful foreign key relationship.

s_company_id (store company identifier) should not reference w_warehouse_sk (warehouse surrogate key). Company and warehouse are different organizational entities. The single distinct value (1) indicates this is likely a constant, not a real foreign key relationship.

web_mkt_id (web site market ID) should not reference cc_call_center_sk (call center surrogate key). Market IDs and call center surrogate keys represent different concepts. Column names suggest different purposes. Coincidental overlap with small cardinality (6 values).

web_company_id (web site company identifier) should not reference cc_call_center_sk (call center surrogate key). Company identifiers and call center surrogate keys are unrelated. Column names indicate different semantic meanings. Coincidental overlap with small cardinality (6 values).
